inorg_particles.description: inorganic particles. Concentration of particles such as sand, grit, metal particles, ceramics, etc.; can include multiple particles

inside_lux.description: inside lux light. The recorded value at sampling time (power density). Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

int_wall_cond.description: interior wall condition. The physical condition of the wall at the time of sampling; photos or video preferred; use drawings to indicate location of damaged areas

intended_consumer.description: intended consumer. Food consumer type, human or animal, for which the food product is produced and marketed. This field accepts terms listed under food consumer group (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/FOODON_03510136) or NCBI taxid

isol_growth_condt.description: isolation and growth condition. Publication reference in the form of pubmed ID (pmid), digital object identifier (doi) or url for isolation and growth condition specifications of the organism/material. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

iw_bt_date_well.description: injection water breakthrough date of specific well. Injection water breakthrough date per well following a secondary and/or tertiary recovery

iwf.description: injection water fraction. Proportion of the produced fluids derived from injected water at the time of sampling. (e.g. 87%). Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

kidney_disord.description: urine/kidney disorder. History of kidney disorders; can include multiple disorders. The terms should be chosen from the DO (Human Disease Ontology) at http://www.disease-ontology.org, kidney disease (https://disease-ontology.org/?id=DOID:557)

last_clean.description: last time swept/mopped/vacuumed. The last time the floor was cleaned (swept, mopped, vacuumed)

lat_lon.description: geographic location (latitude and longitude). The geographical origin of the sample as defined by latitude and longitude. The values should be reported in decimal degrees, limited to 8 decimal points, and in WGS84 system. Syntax: ^{lat} {lon}$

lib_layout.description: library layout. Specify whether to expect single, paired, or other configuration of reads

lib_reads_seqd.description: library reads sequenced. Total number of clones sequenced from the library

lib_screen.description: library screening strategy. Specific enrichment or screening methods applied before and/or after creating libraries

lib_size.description: library size. Total number of clones in the library prepared for the project

lib_vector.description: library vector. Cloning vector type(s) used in construction of libraries

library_prep_kit.description: library preparation kit. Packaged kits (containing adapters, indexes, enzymes, buffers etc.), tailored for specific sequencing workflows, which allow the simplified preparation of sequencing-ready libraries for small genomes, amplicons, and plasmids

light_intensity.description: light intensity. Measurement of light intensity. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

light_regm.description: light regimen. Information about treatment(s) involving exposure to light, including both light intensity and quality

light_type.description: light type. Application of light to achieve some practical or aesthetic effect. Lighting includes the use of both artificial light sources such as lamps and light fixtures, as well as natural illumination by capturing daylight. Can also include absence of light

link_addit_analys.description: links to additional analysis. Link to additional analysis results performed on the sample. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

link_class_info.description: link to classification information. Link to digitized soil maps or other soil classification information

link_climate_info.description: link to climate information. Link to climate resource. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

lithology.description: lithology. Hydrocarbon resource main lithology (Additional information: http://petrowiki.org/Lithology_and_rock_type_determination). If "other" is specified, please propose entry in "additional info" field

liver_disord.description: liver disorder. History of liver disorders; can include multiple disorders. The terms should be chosen from the DO (Human Disease Ontology) at http://www.disease-ontology.org, liver disease (https://disease-ontology.org/?id=DOID:409)

local_class.description: soil_taxonomic/local classification. Soil classification based on local soil classification system

local_class_meth.description: soil_taxonomic/local classification method. Reference or method used in determining the local soil classification. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

lot_number.description: lot number. A distinctive alpha-numeric identification code assigned by the manufacturer or distributor to a specific quantity of manufactured material or product within a batch. Synonym: Batch Number.  The submitter should provide lot number of the item followed by the item name for which the lot number was provided

mag_cov_software.description: MAG coverage software. Tool(s) used to determine the genome coverage if coverage is used as a binning parameter in the extraction of genomes from metagenomic datasets

magnesium.description: magnesium. Concentration of magnesium in the sample. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

maternal_health_stat.description: amniotic fluid/maternal health status. Specification of the maternal health status

max_occup.description: maximum occupancy. The maximum amount of people allowed in the indoor environment. Syntax: ^{integer} {text}$

mean_frict_vel.description: mean friction velocity. Measurement of mean friction velocity. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

mean_peak_frict_vel.description: mean peak friction velocity. Measurement of mean peak friction velocity. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

mech_struc.description: mechanical structure. mechanical structure: a moving structure

mechanical_damage.description: mechanical damage. Information about any mechanical damage exerted on the plant; can include multiple damages and sites

medic_hist_perform.description: medical history performed. Whether full medical history was collected

menarche.description: menarche. Date of most recent menstruation

menopause.description: menopause. Date of onset of menopause

methane.description: methane. Methane (gas) amount or concentration at the time of sampling. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

micro_biomass_meth.description: microbial biomass method. Reference or method used in determining microbial biomass. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

microb_cult_med.description: microbiological culture medium. A culture medium used to select for, grow, and maintain prokaryotic microorganisms. Can be in either liquid (broth) or solidified (e.g. with agar) forms. This field accepts terms listed under microbiological culture medium (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MICRO_0000067). If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the culture medium. Syntax: ^({text}|({termLabel} \[{termID}\]))$

microb_start.description: microbial starter. Any type of microorganisms used in food production.  This field accepts terms listed under live organisms for food production (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/FOODON_0344453)

microb_start_count.value: total prokaryotes;3.5e9 colony forming units per milliliter;spread plate
microb_start_count.description: microbial starter organism count. Total cell count of starter culture per gram, volume or area of sample and the method that was used for the enumeration (e.g. qPCR, atp, mpn, etc.) should also be provided. (example : total prokaryotes; 3.5e7 cells per ml; qPCR)

microb_start_inoc.description: microbial starter inoculation. The amount of starter culture used to inoculate a new batch. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

microb_start_prep.value: liquid starter culture, propagated 3 cycles in milk prior to inoculation
microb_start_prep.description: microbial starter preparation. Information about the protocol or method used to prepare the starter inoculum

microb_start_source.description: microbial starter source. The source from which the microbial starter culture was sourced.  If commercially supplied, list supplier

microb_start_taxID.description: microbial starter NCBI taxonomy ID. Please include Genus species and strain ID, if known of microorganisms used in food production. For complex communities, pipes can be used to separate two or more microbes. Syntax: ^(({termLabel} \[{termID}\])|{integer})$

microbial_biomass.description: microbial biomass. The part of the organic matter in the soil that constitutes living microorganisms smaller than 5-10 micrometer. If you keep this, you would need to have correction factors used for conversion to the final units. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

mid.description: multiplex identifiers. Molecular barcodes, called Multiplex Identifiers (MIDs), that are used to specifically tag unique samples in a sequencing run. Sequence should be reported in uppercase letters. Syntax: ^{dna_bases}$

mineral_nutr_regm.description: mineral nutrient regimen. Information about treatment involving the use of mineral supplements; should include the name of mineral nutrient, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple mineral nutrient regimens

misc_param.value: Bicarbonate ion concentration;2075 micromole per kilogram
misc_param.description: miscellaneous parameter. Any other measurement performed or parameter collected, that is not listed here

mode_transmission.description: mode of transmission. The process through which the symbiotic host organism entered the host from which it was sampled

n_alkanes.description: n-alkanes. Concentration of n-alkanes; can include multiple n-alkanes

neg_cont_type.description: negative control type. The substance or equipment used as a negative control in an investigation

nitrate.description: nitrate. Concentration of nitrate in the sample. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

nitrite.description: nitrite. Concentration of nitrite in the sample. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

non_min_nutr_regm.description: non-mineral nutrient regimen. Information about treatment involving the exposure of plant to non-mineral nutrient such as oxygen, hydrogen or carbon; should include the name of non-mineral nutrient, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple non-mineral nutrient regimens

nose_mouth_teeth_throat_disord.description: nose/mouth/teeth/throat disorder. History of nose/mouth/teeth/throat disorders; can include multiple disorders. The terms should be chosen from the DO (Human Disease Ontology) at http://www.disease-ontology.org, nose disease (https://disease-ontology.org/?id=DOID:2825), mouth disease (https://disease-ontology.org/?id=DOID:403), tooth disease (https://disease-ontology.org/?id=DOID:1091), or upper respiratory tract disease (https://disease-ontology.org/?id=DOID:974)

nose_throat_disord.description: nose throat disorder. Report any history of nose, mouth, teeth and/or throat disorders in the subject. May include multiple disorders.

nucl_acid_amp.description: nucleic acid amplification. A link to a literature reference, electronic resource or a standard operating procedure (SOP), that describes the enzymatic amplification (PCR, TMA, NASBA) of specific nucleic acids. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

nucl_acid_ext.description: nucleic acid extraction. A link to a literature reference, electronic resource or a standard operating procedure (SOP), that describes the material separation to recover the nucleic acid fraction from a sample. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

nucl_acid_ext_kit.description: nucleic acid extraction kit. The name of the extraction kit used to recover the nucleic acid fraction of an input material is performed

num_replicons.description: number of replicons. Reports the number of replicons in a nuclear genome of eukaryotes, in the genome of a bacterium or archaea or the number of segments in a segmented virus. Always applied to the haploid chromosome count of a eukaryote

num_samp_collect.description: number of samples collected. The number of samples collected during the current sampling event. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

number_contig.description: number of contigs. Total number of contigs in the cleaned/submitted assembly that makes up a given genome, SAG, MAG, or UViG

number_pets.description: number of pets. The number of pets residing in the sampled space. Syntax: ^{integer} {text}$

number_plants.description: number of houseplants. The number of plant(s) in the sampling space. Syntax: ^{integer} {text}$

number_resident.description: number of residents. The number of individuals currently occupying in the sampling location. Syntax: ^{integer} {text}$

occup_density_samp.description: occupant density at sampling. Average number of occupants at time of sampling per square footage

occup_document.description: occupancy documentation. The type of documentation of occupancy

occup_samp.description: occupancy at sampling. Number of occupants present at time of sample within the given space. Syntax: ^{integer} {text}$

org_carb.description: organic carbon. Concentration of organic carbon. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

org_count_qpcr_info.description: organism count qPCR information. If qpcr was used for the cell count, the target gene name, the primer sequence and the cycling conditions should also be provided. (Example: 16S rrna; FWD:ACGTAGCTATGACGT REV:GTGCTAGTCGAGTAC; initial denaturation:90C_5min; denaturation:90C_2min; annealing:52C_30 sec; elongation:72C_30 sec; 90 C for 1 min; final elongation:72C_5min; 30 cycles)

org_matter.description: organic matter. Concentration of organic matter. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

org_nitro.description: organic nitrogen. Concentration of organic nitrogen. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

org_particles.description: organic particles. Concentration of particles such as faeces, hairs, food, vomit, paper fibers, plant material, humus, etc

organism_count.description: organism count. Total cell count of any organism (or group of organisms) per gram, volume or area of sample, should include name of organism followed by count. The method that was used for the enumeration (e.g. qPCR, atp, mpn, etc.) Should also be provided. (example: total prokaryotes; 3.5e7 cells per ml; qpcr)

otu_class_appr.description: OTU classification approach. Cutoffs and approach used when clustering species-level OTUs. Note that results from standard 95% ANI / 85% AF clustering should be provided alongside OTUs defined from another set of thresholds, even if the latter are the ones primarily used during the analysis. Syntax: ^{integer}%\s*ANI;\s*{integer}%\s*AF;\s*{text}$

otu_db.description: OTU database. Reference database (i.e. sequences not generated as part of the current study) used to cluster new genomes in "species-level" OTUs, if any

otu_seq_comp_appr.description: OTU sequence comparison approach. Tool and thresholds used to compare sequences when computing "species-level" OTUs

owc_tvdss.description: oil water contact depth. Depth of the original oil water contact (OWC) zone (average) (m TVDSS). Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

oxy_stat_samp.description: oxygenation status of sample. Oxygenation status of sample

oxygen.description: oxygen. Oxygen (gas) amount or concentration at the time of sampling. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

part_org_carb.description: particulate organic carbon. Concentration of particulate organic carbon. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

part_org_nitro.description: particulate organic nitrogen. Concentration of particulate organic nitrogen. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

part_plant_animal.description: part of plant or animal. The anatomical part of the organism being involved in food production or consumption; e.g., a carrot is the root of the plant (root vegetable). This field accepts terms listed under part of plant or animal (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/FOODON_03420116)

particle_class.description: particle classification. Particles are classified, based on their size, into six general categories:clay, silt, sand, gravel, cobbles, and boulders; should include amount of particle preceded by the name of the particle type; can include multiple values

pathogenicity.description: known pathogenicity. To what is the entity pathogenic

pcr_cond.description: pcr conditions. Description of reaction conditions and components of polymerase chain reaction performed during library preparation.

pcr_primers.description: pcr primers. PCR primers that were used to amplify the sequence of the targeted gene, locus or subfragment. This field should contain all the primers used for a single PCR reaction if multiple forward or reverse primers are present in a single PCR reaction. The primer sequence should be reported in uppercase letters. Syntax: FWD:{dna_bases};REV:{dna_bases}

permeability.description: permeability. Measure of the ability of a hydrocarbon resource to allow fluids to pass through it. (Additional information: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Permeability_(earth_sciences))

perturbation.description: perturbation. Type of perturbation, e.g. chemical administration, physical disturbance, etc., coupled with perturbation regimen including how many times the perturbation was repeated, how long each perturbation lasted, and the start and end time of the entire perturbation period; can include multiple perturbation types

pesticide_regm.description: pesticide regimen. Information about treatment involving use of insecticides; should include the name of pesticide, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple pesticide regimens

pet_farm_animal.description: presence of pets or farm animals. Specification of presence of pets or farm animals in the environment of subject, if yes the animals should be specified; can include multiple animals present

petroleum_hydrocarb.description: petroleum hydrocarbon. Concentration of petroleum hydrocarbon. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

ph.description: pH. pH measurement of the sample, or liquid portion of sample, or aqueous phase of the fluid

ph_meth.description: pH method. Reference or method used in determining pH. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

ph_regm.description: pH regimen. Information about treatment involving exposure of plants to varying levels of ph of the growth media, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimen

phaeopigments.description: phaeopigments. Concentration of phaeopigments; can include multiple phaeopigments

phosplipid_fatt_acid.description: phospholipid fatty acid. Concentration of phospholipid fatty acids; can include multiple values

photon_flux.value: 3.926 micromole photons per second per square meter
photon_flux.description: photon flux. Measurement of photon flux. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

photosynt_activ.description: photosynthetic activity. Measurement of photosythetic activity (i.e. leaf gas exchange / chlorophyll fluorescence emissions / reflectance / transpiration) Please also include the term method term detailing the method of activity measurement. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

photosynt_activ_meth.description: photosynthetic activity method. Reference or method used in measurement of photosythetic activity. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL}|{text})$

plant_growth_med.description: plant growth medium. Specification of the media for growing the plants or tissue cultured samples, e.g. soil, aeroponic, hydroponic, in vitro solid culture medium, in vitro liquid culture medium. Recommended value is a specific value from PECO:plant growth medium exposure (follow this link for terms http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/PECO_0007147) or other controlled vocabulary

plant_part_maturity.description: degree of plant part maturity. A description of the stage of development of a plant or plant part based on maturity or ripeness. This field accepts terms listed under degree of plant maturity (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/FOODON_03530050)

plant_product.description: plant product. Substance produced by the plant, where the sample was obtained from

plant_reprod_crop.description: plant reproductive part. Plant reproductive part used in the field during planting to start the crop

plant_sex.description: plant sex. Sex of the reproductive parts on the whole plant, e.g. pistillate, staminate, monoecieous, hermaphrodite

plant_struc.description: plant structure. Name of plant structure the sample was obtained from; for Plant Ontology (PO) (v releases/2017-12-14) terms, see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/PO, e.g. petiole epidermis (PO_0000051). If an individual flower is sampled, the sex of it can be recorded here. Syntax: ^{termLabel} \[{termID}\]$

plant_water_method.description: plant water delivery method. Description of the equipment or method used to distribute water to crops. This field accepts termed listed under irrigation process (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/AGRO_00000006). Multiple terms can be separated by pipes. Syntax: ^{termLabel} \[{termID}\]$

ploidy.description: ploidy. The ploidy level of the genome (e.g. allopolyploid, haploid, diploid, triploid, tetraploid). It has implications for the downstream study of duplicated gene and regions of the genomes (and perhaps for difficulties in assembly). For terms, please select terms listed under class ploidy (PATO:001374) of Phenotypic Quality Ontology (PATO), and for a browser of PATO (v 2018-03-27) please refer to http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/PATO. Syntax: ^{termLabel} \[{termID}\]$

pollutants.description: pollutants. Pollutant types and, amount or concentrations measured at the time of sampling; can report multiple pollutants by entering numeric values preceded by name of pollutant

pool_dna_extracts.description: pooling of DNA extracts (if done). Indicate whether multiple DNA extractions were mixed. If the answer yes, the number of extracts that were pooled should be given

porosity.description: porosity. Porosity of deposited sediment is volume of voids divided by the total volume of sample

pos_cont_type.description: positive control type. The substance, mixture, product, or apparatus used to verify that a process which is part of an investigation delivers a true positive

potassium.description: potassium. Concentration of potassium in the sample. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

pour_point.description: pour point. Temperature at which a liquid becomes semi solid and loses its flow characteristics. In crude oil a high pour point is generally associated with a high paraffin content, typically found in crude deriving from a larger proportion of plant material.. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

pre_treatment.description: pre-treatment. The process of pre-treatment removes materials that can be easily collected from the raw wastewater

pred_genome_struc.description: predicted genome structure. Expected structure of the viral genome

pred_genome_type.description: predicted genome type. Type of genome predicted for the UViG

pres_animal_insect.description: presence of pets, animals, or insects. The type and number of animals or insects present in the sampling space

pressure.description: pressure. Pressure to which the sample is subject to, in atmospheres. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

prev_land_use_meth.description: history/previous land use method. Reference or method used in determining previous land use and dates. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

previous_land_use.description: history/previous land use. Previous land use and dates

primary_prod.value: 100 milligram per cubic meter per day
primary_prod.description: primary production. Measurement of primary production, generally measured as isotope uptake. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

primary_treatment.description: primary treatment. The process to produce both a generally homogeneous liquid capable of being treated biologically and a sludge that can be separately treated or processed

prod_label_claims.description: production labeling claims. Labeling claims containing descriptors such as wild caught, free-range, organic, free-range, industrial, hormone-free, antibiotic free, cage free. Can include more than one term, separated by ";"

prod_rate.description: production rate. Oil and/or gas production rates per well (e.g. 524 m3 / day). Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

prod_start_date.description: production start date. Date of field's first production

profile_position.description: profile position. Cross-sectional position in the hillslope where sample was collected.sample area position in relation to surrounding areas

project_name.description: project name. Name of the project within which the sequencing was organized

propagation.description: propagation. The type of reproduction from the parent stock. Values for this field is specific to different taxa. For phage or virus: lytic/lysogenic/temperate/obligately lytic. For plasmids: incompatibility group. For eukaryotes: sexual/asexual

pulmonary_disord.description: lung/pulmonary disorder. History of pulmonary disorders; can include multiple disorders. The terms should be chosen from the DO (Human Disease Ontology) at http://www.disease-ontology.org, lung disease (https://disease-ontology.org/?id=DOID:850)

quad_pos.description: quadrant position. The quadrant position of the sampling room within the building

radiation_regm.description: radiation regimen. Information about treatment involving exposure of plant or a plant part to a particular radiation regimen; should include the radiation type, amount or intensity administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple radiation regimens

rainfall_regm.description: rainfall regimen. Information about treatment involving an exposure to a given amount of rainfall, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

reactor_type.description: reactor type. Anaerobic digesters can be designed and engineered to operate using a number of different process configurations, as batch or continuous, mesophilic, high solid or low solid, and single stage or multistage

reassembly_bin.description: reassembly post binning. Has an assembly been performed on a genome bin extracted from a metagenomic assembly?

redox_potential.description: redox potential. Redox potential, measured relative to a hydrogen cell, indicating oxidation or reduction potential. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

ref_biomaterial.description: reference for biomaterial. Primary publication if isolated before genome publication; otherwise, primary genome report. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

ref_db.description: reference database(s). List of database(s) used for ORF annotation, along with version number and reference to website or publication

rel_air_humidity.description: relative air humidity. Partial vapor and air pressure, density of the vapor and air, or by the actual mass of the vapor and air. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

rel_humidity_out.description: outside relative humidity. The recorded outside relative humidity value at the time of sampling. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

rel_location.description: relative location of sample. Location of sampled soil to other parts of the farm e.g. under crop plant, near irrigation ditch, from the dirt road

rel_samp_loc.description: relative sampling location. The sampling location within the train car

rel_to_oxygen.description: relationship to oxygen. Is this organism an aerobe, anaerobe? Please note that aerobic and anaerobic are valid descriptors for microbial environments

repository_name.description: repository name. The name of the institution where the sample or DNA extract is held or "sample not available" if the sample was used in its entirety for analysis or otherwise not retained

reservoir.description: reservoir name. Name of the reservoir (e.g. Carapebus)

resins_pc.description: resins wt%. Saturate, Aromatic, Resin and Asphaltene (SARA) is an analysis method that divides crude oil components according to their polarizability and polarity. There are three main methods to obtain SARA results. The most popular one is known as the Iatroscan TLC-FID and is referred to as IP-143 (source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saturate,_aromatic,_resin_and_asphaltene). Syntax: ^{name};{float} {unit}$

room_air_exch_rate.description: room air exchange rate. The rate at which outside air replaces indoor air in a given space. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

room_architec_elem.description: room architectural elements. The unique details and component parts that, together, form the architecture of a distinguishable space within a built structure

room_condt.description: room condition. The condition of the room at the time of sampling

room_connected.description: rooms connected by a doorway. List of rooms connected to the sampling room by a doorway

room_count.description: room count. The total count of rooms in the built structure including all room types

room_dim.description: room dimensions. The length, width and height of sampling room

room_door_dist.description: room door distance. Distance between doors (meters) in the hallway between the sampling room and adjacent rooms. Syntax: ^{integer} {text}$

room_door_share.description: rooms that share a door with sampling room. List of room(s) (room number, room name) sharing a door with the sampling room. Syntax: ^{room_name};{room_number}$

room_hallway.description: rooms that are on the same hallway. List of room(s) (room number, room name) located in the same hallway as sampling room. Syntax: ^{room_name};{room_number}$

room_loc.description: room location in building. The position of the room within the building

room_moist_dam_hist.description: room moisture damage or mold history. The history of moisture damage or mold in the past 12 months. Number of events of moisture damage or mold observed

room_net_area.description: room net area. The net floor area of sampling room. Net area excludes wall thicknesses. Syntax: ^{integer} {text}$

room_occup.description: room occupancy. Count of room occupancy at time of sampling. Syntax: ^{integer} {text}$

room_samp_pos.description: room sampling position. The horizontal sampling position in the room relative to architectural elements

room_type.description: room type. The main purpose or activity of the sampling room. A room is any distinguishable space within a structure

room_vol.description: room volume. Volume of sampling room. Syntax: ^{integer} {text}$

room_wall_share.description: rooms that share a wall with sampling room. List of room(s) (room number, room name) sharing a wall with the sampling room. Syntax: ^{room_name};{room_number}$

room_window_count.description: room window count. Number of windows in the room

root_cond.description: rooting conditions. Relevant rooting conditions such as field plot size, sowing density, container dimensions, number of plants per container. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL}|{text})$

root_med_carbon.description: rooting medium carbon. Source of organic carbon in the culture rooting medium; e.g. sucrose

root_med_macronutr.description: rooting medium macronutrients. Measurement of the culture rooting medium macronutrients (N,P, K, Ca, Mg, S); e.g. KH2PO4 (170 mg/L)

root_med_micronutr.description: rooting medium micronutrients. Measurement of the culture rooting medium micronutrients (Fe, Mn, Zn, B, Cu, Mo); e.g. H3BO3 (6.2 mg/L)

root_med_ph.description: rooting medium pH. pH measurement of the culture rooting medium; e.g. 5.5

root_med_regl.description: rooting medium regulators. Growth regulators in the culture rooting medium such as cytokinins, auxins, gybberellins, abscisic acid; e.g. 0.5  mg/L NAA

root_med_solid.description: rooting medium solidifier. Specification of the solidifying agent in the culture rooting medium; e.g. agar

root_med_suppl.description: rooting medium organic supplements. Organic supplements of the culture rooting medium, such as vitamins, amino acids, organic acids, antibiotics activated charcoal; e.g. nicotinic acid (0.5  mg/L)

route_transmission.description: route of transmission. Description of path taken by the symbiotic host organism being sampled in order to establish a symbiotic relationship with the host (with which it was observed at the time of sampling) via a mode of transmission (specified in mode_transmission)

salinity.description: salinity. The total concentration of all dissolved salts in a liquid or solid sample. While salinity can be measured by a complete chemical analysis, this method is difficult and time consuming. More often, it is instead derived from the conductivity measurement. This is known as practical salinity. These derivations compare the specific conductance of the sample to a salinity standard such as seawater. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

salt_regm.description: salt regimen. Information about treatment involving use of salts as supplement to liquid and soil growth media; should include the name of salt, amount administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple salt regimens

samp_capt_status.description: sample capture status. Reason for the sample

samp_collect_device.description: sample collection device. The device used to collect an environmental sample. This field accepts terms listed under environmental sampling device (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO). This field also accepts terms listed under specimen collection device (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENEPIO_0002094)

samp_collect_method.description: sample collection method. The method employed for collecting the sample. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL}|{text})$

samp_collect_point.description: sample collection point. Sampling point on the asset were sample was collected (e.g. Wellhead, storage tank, separator, etc). If "other" is specified, please propose entry in "additional info" field

samp_dis_stage.description: sample disease stage. Stage of the disease at the time of sample collection, e.g. inoculation, penetration, infection, growth and reproduction, dissemination of pathogen

samp_floor.description: sampling floor. The floor of the building, where the sampling room is located

samp_loc_condition.description: sample location condition. The condition of the sample location at the time of sampling

samp_loc_corr_rate.description: corrosion rate at sample location. Metal corrosion rate is the speed of metal deterioration due to environmental conditions. As environmental conditions change corrosion rates change accordingly. Therefore, long term corrosion rates are generally more informative than short term rates and for that reason they are preferred during reporting. In the case of suspected MIC, corrosion rate measurements at the time of sampling might provide insights into the involvement of certain microbial community members in MIC as well as potential microbial interplays. Syntax: ^{float} *- *{float} {unit}$

samp_mat_process.value: filtering of seawater, storing samples in ethanol
samp_mat_process.description: sample material processing. A brief description of any processing applied to the sample during or after retrieving the sample from environment, or a link to the relevant protocol(s) performed

samp_md.description: sample measured depth. In non deviated well, measured depth is equal to the true vertical depth, TVD (TVD=TVDSS plus the reference or datum it refers to). In deviated wells, the MD is the length of trajectory of the borehole measured from the same reference or datum. Common datums used are ground level (GL), drilling rig floor (DF), rotary table (RT), kelly bushing (KB) and mean sea level (MSL). If "other" is specified, please propose entry in "additional info" field

samp_name.description: sample name. A local identifier or name that for the material sample used for extracting nucleic acids, and subsequent sequencing. It can refer either to the original material collected or to any derived sub-samples. It can have any format, but we suggest that you make it concise, unique and consistent within your lab, and as informative as possible. INSDC requires every sample name from a single Submitter to be unique. Use of a globally unique identifier for the field source_mat_id is recommended in addition to sample_name

samp_pooling.value: 5uL of extracted genomic DNA from 5 leaves were pooled
samp_pooling.description: sample pooling. Physical combination of several instances of like material, e.g. RNA extracted from samples or dishes of cell cultures into one big aliquot of cells. Please provide a short description of the samples that were pooled

samp_preserv.description: preservative added to sample. Preservative added to the sample (e.g. Rnalater, alcohol, formaldehyde, etc.). Where appropriate include volume added (e.g. Rnalater; 2 ml). Syntax: ^{name};{float} {unit}$

samp_purpose.description: purpose of sampling. The reason that the sample was collected

samp_rep_biol.description: biological sample replicate. Measurements of biologically distinct samples that show biological variation. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

samp_rep_tech.description: technical sample replicate. Repeated measurements of the same sample that show independent measures of the noise associated with the equipment and the protocols. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

samp_room_id.description: sampling room ID or name. Sampling room number. This ID should be consistent with the designations on the building floor plans

samp_size.description: amount or size of sample collected. The total amount or size (volume (ml), mass (g) or area (m2) ) of sample collected. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

samp_sort_meth.description: sample size sorting method. Method by which samples are sorted; open face filter collecting total suspended particles, prefilter to remove particles larger than X micrometers in diameter, where common values of X would be 10 and 2.5 full size sorting in a cascade impactor

samp_source_mat_cat.description: sample source material category. This is the scientific role or category that the subject organism or material has with respect to an investigation.  This field accepts terms listed under specimen source material category (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENEPIO_0001237 or http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0100051)

samp_stor_device.description: sample storage device. The container used to store the  sample. This field accepts terms listed under container (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C43186). If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the storage device

samp_stor_media.description: sample storage media. The liquid that is added to the sample collection device prior to sampling. If the sample is pre-hydrated, indicate the liquid media the sample is pre-hydrated with for storage purposes. This field accepts terms listed under microbiological culture medium (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MICRO_0000067). If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the sample storage media. Syntax: ^({text}|({termLabel} \[{termID}\]))$

samp_store_dur.description: sample storage duration. Duration for which the sample was stored. Indicate the duration for which the sample was stored written in ISO 8601 format. Syntax: ^{duration}$

samp_store_loc.description: sample storage location. Location at which sample was stored, usually name of a specific freezer/room

samp_store_sol.description: sample storage solution. Solution within which sample was stored, if any

samp_store_temp.description: sample storage temperature. Temperature at which sample was stored, e.g. -80 degree Celsius. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

samp_subtype.description: sample subtype. Name of sample sub-type. For example if "sample type" is "Produced Water" then subtype could be "Oil Phase" or "Water Phase". If "other" is specified, please propose entry in "additional info" field

samp_surf_moisture.description: sample surface moisture. Degree of water held on a sampled surface.  If present, user can state the degree of water held on surface (intermittent moisture, submerged). If no surface moisture is present indicate not present

samp_taxon_id.description: taxonomy ID of DNA sample. NCBI taxon id of the sample.  Maybe be a single taxon or mixed taxa sample. Use 'synthetic metagenome  for mock community/positive controls, or 'blank sample' for negative controls. Syntax: ^{text} \[{NCBItaxon_id}\]$

samp_time_out.description: sampling time outside. The recent and long term history of outside sampling

samp_transport_cond.description: sample transport conditions. Sample transport duration (in days or hrs) and temperature the sample was exposed to (e.g. 5.5 days; 20   C)

samp_transport_cont.description: sample transport container. Container in which the sample was stored during transport. Indicate the location name

samp_transport_dur.description: sample transport duration. The duration of time from when the sample was collected until processed. Indicate the duration for which the sample was stored written in ISO 8601 format. Syntax: ^{duration}$

samp_transport_temp.description: sample transport temperature. Temperature at which sample was transported, e.g. -20 or 4 degree Celsius

samp_tvdss.description: sample true vertical depth subsea. Depth of the sample i.e. The vertical distance between the sea level and the sampled position in the subsurface. Depth can be reported as an interval for subsurface samples e.g. 1325.75-1362.25 m

samp_type.description: sample type. The type of material from which the sample was obtained. For the Hydrocarbon package, samples include types like core, rock trimmings, drill cuttings, piping section, coupon, pigging debris, solid deposit, produced fluid, produced water, injected water, swabs, etc. For the Food Package, samples are usually categorized as food, body products or tissues, or environmental material. This field accepts terms listed under environmental specimen (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENEPIO_0001246). Syntax: ^{termLabel} \[{termID}\]$

samp_vol_we_dna_ext.description: sample volume or weight for DNA extraction. Volume (ml) or mass (g) of total collected sample processed for DNA extraction. Note: total sample collected should be entered under the term Sample Size (MIXS:0000001). Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

samp_weather.description: sampling day weather. The weather on the sampling day

samp_well_name.description: sample well name. Name of the well (e.g. BXA1123) where sample was taken

saturates_pc.description: saturates wt%. Saturate, Aromatic, Resin and Asphaltene (SARA) is an analysis method that divides crude oil components according to their polarizability and polarity. There are three main methods to obtain SARA results. The most popular one is known as the Iatroscan TLC-FID and is referred to as IP-143 (source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saturate,_aromatic,_resin_and_asphaltene). Syntax: ^{name};{float} {unit}$

sc_lysis_approach.description: single cell or viral particle lysis approach. Method used to free DNA from interior of the cell(s) or particle(s)

sc_lysis_method.description: single cell or viral particle lysis kit protocol. Name of the kit or standard protocol used for cell(s) or particle(s) lysis

season.description: season. The season when sampling occurred. Any of the four periods into which the year is divided by the equinoxes and solstices.

season_environment.description: seasonal environment. Treatment involving an exposure to a particular season (e.g. Winter, summer, rabi, rainy etc.), treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment

season_humidity.description: mean seasonal humidity. Average humidity of the region throughout the growing season. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

season_precpt.description: mean seasonal precipitation. The average of all seasonal precipitation values known, or an estimated equivalent value derived by such methods as regional indexes or Isohyetal maps. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

season_temp.description: mean seasonal temperature. Mean seasonal temperature. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

season_use.description: seasonal use. The seasons the space is occupied

secondary_treatment.description: secondary treatment. The process for substantially degrading the biological content of the sewage

sediment_type.description: sediment type. Information about the sediment type based on major constituents

seq_meth.description: sequencing method. Sequencing machine used. Where possible the term should be taken from the OBI list of DNA sequencers (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0400103). Syntax: ^({text}|({termLabel} \[{termID}\]))$

seq_quality_check.description: sequence quality check. Indicate if the sequence has been called by automatic systems (none) or undergone a manual editing procedure (e.g. by inspecting the raw data or chromatograms). Applied only for sequences that are not submitted to SRA,ENA or DRA

sequencing_kit.value: NextSeq 500/550 High Output Kit v2.5 (75 Cycles)
sequencing_kit.description: sequencing kit. Pre-filled, ready-to-use reagent cartridges. Used to produce improved chemistry, cluster density and read length as well as improve quality (Q) scores. Reagent components are encoded to interact with the sequencing system to validate compatibility with user-defined applications. Indicate name of the sequencing kit

sequencing_location.value: University of Maryland Genomics Resource Center
sequencing_location.description: sequencing location. The location the sequencing run was performed. Indicate the name of the lab or core facility where samples were sequenced

serovar_or_serotype.description: serovar or serotype. A characterization of a cell or microorganism based on the antigenic properties of the molecules on its surface. Indicate the name of a serovar or serotype of interest. This field accepts terms under organism (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C14250). This field also accepts identification numbers from NCBI under https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy. Syntax: ^(({termLabel} \[{termID}\])|{integer})$

sewage_type.description: sewage type. Type of wastewater treatment plant as municipial or industrial

sexual_act.description: sexual activity. Current sexual partner and frequency of sex

shad_dev_water_mold.description: shading device signs of water/mold. Signs of the presence of mold or mildew on the shading device

shading_device_cond.description: shading device condition. The physical condition of the shading device at the time of sampling

shading_device_loc.description: shading device location. The location of the shading device in relation to the built structure

shading_device_mat.description: shading device material. The material the shading device is composed of

shading_device_type.description: shading device type. The type of shading device

sieving.description: sieving. Collection design of pooled samples and/or sieve size and amount of sample sieved

sim_search_meth.description: similarity search method. Tool used to compare ORFs with database, along with version and cutoffs used. Syntax: ^{software};{version};{parameters}$

size_frac.description: size fraction selected. Filtering pore size used in sample preparation

size_frac_low.description: size-fraction lower threshold. Refers to the mesh/pore size used to pre-filter/pre-sort the sample. Materials smaller than the size threshold are excluded from the sample. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

size_frac_up.description: size-fraction upper threshold. Mesh or pore size of the device used to retain the sample. Materials larger than the size threshold are excluded from the sample.. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

slope_aspect.description: slope aspect. The direction a slope faces. While looking down a slope use a compass to record the direction you are facing (direction or degrees); e.g., nw or 315 degrees. This measure provides an indication of sun and wind exposure that will influence soil temperature and evapotranspiration. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

slope_gradient.description: slope gradient. Commonly called 'slope'. The angle between ground surface and a horizontal line (in percent). This is the direction that overland water would flow. This measure is usually taken with a hand level meter or clinometer. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

sludge_retent_time.description: sludge retention time. The time activated sludge remains in reactor. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

sodium.description: sodium. Sodium concentration in the sample. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

soil_conductivity.description: soil conductivity. Conductivity of some soil.. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

soil_cover.description: soil cover. Material covering the sampled soil. This field accepts terms under ENVO:00010483, environmental material

soil_horizon.description: soil horizon. Specific layer in the land area which measures parallel to the soil surface and possesses physical characteristics which differ from the layers above and beneath

soil_pH.description: soil pH. pH measurement of some soil at the time of sampling

soil_porosity.description: soil sediment porosity. Porosity of soil or deposited sediment is volume of voids divided by the total volume of sample

soil_temp.description: soil temperature. Temperature of soil at the time of sampling. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

soil_texture.description: soil texture. The relative proportion of different grain sizes of mineral particles in a soil, as described using a standard system; express as % sand (50 um to 2 mm), silt (2 um to 50 um), and clay (<2 um) with textural name (e.g., silty clay loam) optional. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

soil_texture_class.description: soil texture classification. One of the 12 soil texture classes use to describe soil texture based on the relative proportion of different grain sizes  of mineral particles [sand (50 um to 2 mm), silt (2 um to 50 um), and clay (<2 um)] in a soil

soil_texture_meth.description: soil texture method. Reference or method used in determining soil texture. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

soil_type.description: soil type. Description of the soil type or classification. This field accepts terms under soil (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_00001998).  Multiple terms can be separated by pipes

soil_type_meth.description: soil type method. Reference or method used in determining soil series name or other lower-level classification. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

solar_irradiance.value: 1.36 kilowatts per square meter per day
solar_irradiance.description: solar irradiance. The amount of solar energy that arrives at a specific area of a surface during a specific time interval. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

soluble_inorg_mat.description: soluble inorganic material. Concentration of substances such as ammonia, road-salt, sea-salt, cyanide, hydrogen sulfide, thiocyanates, thiosulfates, etc

soluble_org_mat.description: soluble organic material. Concentration of substances such as urea, fruit sugars, soluble proteins, drugs, pharmaceuticals, etc

soluble_react_phosp.description: soluble reactive phosphorus. Concentration of soluble reactive phosphorus. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

sop.description: relevant standard operating procedures. Standard operating procedures used in assembly and/or annotation of genomes, metagenomes or environmental sequences. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL})$

sort_tech.description: sorting technology. Method used to sort/isolate cells or particles of interest

source_mat_id.description: source material identifiers. A unique identifier assigned to a material sample (as defined by http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/materialSampleID, and as opposed to a particular digital record of a material sample) used for extracting nucleic acids, and subsequent sequencing. The identifier can refer either to the original material collected or to any derived sub-samples. The INSDC qualifiers /specimen_voucher, /bio_material, or /culture_collection may or may not share the same value as the source_mat_id field. For instance, the /specimen_voucher qualifier and source_mat_id may both contain 'UAM:Herps:14' , referring to both the specimen voucher and sampled tissue with the same identifier. However, the /culture_collection qualifier may refer to a value from an initial culture (e.g. ATCC:11775) while source_mat_id would refer to an identifier from some derived culture from which the nucleic acids were extracted (e.g. xatc123 or ark:/2154/R2)

source_uvig.description: source of UViGs. Type of dataset from which the UViG was obtained

space_typ_state.description: space typical state. Customary or normal state of the space

spec_intended_cons.description: specific intended consumer. Food consumer type, human or animal, for which the food product is produced and marketed. This field accepts terms listed under food consumer group (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/FOODON_03510136). Syntax: ^{termLabel} \[{termID}\]$

special_diet.description: special diet. Specification of special diet; can include multiple special diets

specific.description: specifications. The building specifications. If design is chosen, indicate phase: conceptual, schematic, design development, construction documents

specific_host.description: host scientific name. Report the host's taxonomic name and/or NCBI taxonomy ID

specific_humidity.description: specific humidity. The mass of water vapour in a unit mass of moist air, usually expressed as grams of vapour per kilogram of air, or, in air conditioning, as grains per pound. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

spikein_AMR.description: antimicrobial phenotype of spike-in bacteria. Qualitative description of a microbial response to antimicrobial agents. Bacteria may be susceptible or resistant to a broad range of antibiotic drugs or drug classes, with several intermediate states or phases. This field accepts terms under antimicrobial phenotype (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ARO_3004299)

spikein_antibiotic.description: spike-in with antibiotics. Antimicrobials used in research study to assess effects of exposure on microbiome of a specific site.  Please list antimicrobial, common name and/or class and concentration used for spike-in

spikein_count.value: total prokaryotes;3.5e7 colony forming units per milliliter;qPCR
spikein_count.description: spike-in organism count. Total cell count of any organism (or group of organisms) per gram, volume or area of sample, should include name of organism followed by count. The method that was used for the enumeration (e.g. qPCR, atp, mpn, etc.) should also be provided (example: total prokaryotes; 3.5e7 cells per ml; qPCR)

spikein_growth_med.description: spike-in growth medium. A liquid or gel containing nutrients, salts, and other factors formulated to support the growth of microorganisms, cells, or plants (National Cancer Institute Thesaurus).  A growth medium is a culture medium which has the disposition to encourage growth of particular bacteria to the exclusion of others in the same growth environment.  In this case, list the culture medium used to propagate the spike-in bacteria during preparation of spike-in inoculum. This field accepts terms listed under microbiological culture medium (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MICRO_0000067). If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the spike in growth media. Syntax: ^({text}|({termLabel} \[{termID}\]))$

spikein_metal.description: spike-in with heavy metals. Heavy metals used in research study to assess effects of exposure on microbiome of a specific site.  Please list heavy metals and concentration used for spike-in

spikein_org.description: spike in organism. Taxonomic information about the spike-in organism(s). This field accepts terms under organism (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C14250). This field also accepts identification numbers from NCBI under https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy. Multiple terms can be separated by pipes. Syntax: ^(({termLabel} \[{termID}\])|{integer})$

spikein_serovar.description: spike-in bacterial serovar or serotype. Taxonomic information about the spike-in organism(s) at the serovar or serotype level. This field accepts terms under organism (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C14250). This field also accepts identification numbers from NCBI under https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy. Multiple terms can be separated by pipes

spikein_strain.description: spike-in microbial strain. Taxonomic information about the spike-in organism(s) at the strain level. This field accepts terms under organism (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C14250). This field also accepts identification numbers from NCBI under https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy. Multiple terms can be separated by pipes

sr_dep_env.description: source rock depositional environment. Source rock depositional environment (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Source_rock). If "other" is specified, please propose entry in "additional info" field

sr_geol_age.description: source rock geological age. Geological age of source rock (Additional info: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Period_(geology)). If "other" is specified, please propose entry in "additional info" field

sr_kerog_type.description: source rock kerogen type. Origin of kerogen. Type I: Algal (aquatic), Type II: planktonic and soft plant material (aquatic or terrestrial), Type III: terrestrial woody/ fibrous plant material (terrestrial), Type IV: oxidized recycled woody debris (terrestrial) (additional information: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kerogen). If "other" is specified, please propose entry in "additional info" field

sr_lithology.description: source rock lithology. Lithology of source rock (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Source_rock). If "other" is specified, please propose entry in "additional info" field

standing_water_regm.description: standing water regimen. Treatment involving an exposure to standing water during a plant's life span, types can be flood water or standing water, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

ster_meth_samp_room.description: sampling room sterilization method. The method used to sterilize the sampling room. This field accepts terms listed under electromagnetic radiation (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_01001026). If the proper descriptor is not listed, please use text to describe the sampling room sterilization method. Multiple terms can be separated by pipes

store_cond.description: storage conditions. Explain how and for how long the sample was stored before DNA extraction (for example, fresh/frozen/other). Include factors that may influence nucleic acid recovery or library construction. For example, specify temperature, humidity, presence of microbial overgrowth etc... Syntax: ^{storage_condition_type};{duration}$

study_complt_stat.description: study completion status. Specification of study completion status, if no the reason should be specified. Syntax: ^{boolean};(?:adverse event|non-compliance|lost to follow up|other)$

study_design.description: study design. A plan specification comprised of protocols (which may specify how and what kinds of data will be gathered) that are executed as part of an investigation and is realized during a study design execution. This field accepts terms under study design (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0500000). If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the study design. Multiple terms can be separated by pipes

study_inc_dur.description: study incubation duration. Sample incubation duration if unpublished or unvalidated method is used. Indicate the timepoint written in ISO 8601 format. Syntax: ^{duration}$

study_inc_temp.description: study incubation temperature. Sample incubation temperature if unpublished or unvalidated method is used. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

study_timecourse.description: time-course duration. For time-course research studies involving samples of the food commodity, indicate the total duration of the time-course study. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

study_tmnt.description: study treatment. A process in which the act is intended to modify or alter some other material entity.  From the study design, each treatment is comprised of one level of one or multiple factors. This field accepts terms listed under treatment (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MCO_0000866). If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the study treatment. Multiple terms can be separated by one or more pipes

subspecf_gen_lin.description: subspecific genetic lineage. Information about the genetic distinctness of the sequenced organism below the subspecies level, e.g., serovar, serotype, biotype, ecotype, or any relevant genetic typing schemes like Group I plasmid. Subspecies should not be recorded in this term, but in the NCBI taxonomy. Supply both the lineage name and the lineage rank separated by a colon, e.g., biovar:abc123

substructure_type.description: substructure type. The substructure or under building is that largely hidden section of the building which is built off the foundations to the ground floor level

sulfate.description: sulfate. Concentration of sulfate in the sample. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

sulfate_fw.description: sulfate in formation water. Original sulfate concentration in the hydrocarbon resource. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

sulfide.description: sulfide. Concentration of sulfide in the sample. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

surf_air_cont.description: surface-air contaminant. Contaminant identified on surface

surf_humidity.description: surface humidity. Surfaces: water activity as a function of air and material moisture. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

surf_material.description: surface material. Surface materials at the point of sampling

surf_moisture.description: surface moisture. Water held on a surface. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

surf_moisture_ph.description: surface moisture pH. ph measurement of surface

surf_temp.description: surface temperature. Temperature of the surface at the time of sampling. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

suspend_part_matter.description: suspended particulate matter. Concentration of suspended particulate matter. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

suspend_solids.description: suspended solids. Concentration of substances including a wide variety of material, such as silt, decaying plant and animal matter; can include multiple substances

sym_life_cycle_type.description: symbiotic host organism life cycle type. Type of life cycle of the symbiotic host species (the thing being sampled). Simple life cycles occur within a single host, complex ones within multiple different hosts over the course of their normal life cycle

symbiont_host_role.description: host of the symbiont role. Role of the host in the life cycle of the symbiotic organism

tan.description: total acid number. Total Acid Number (TAN) is a measurement of acidity that is determined by the amount of potassium hydroxide in milligrams that is needed to neutralize the acids in one gram of oil. It is an important quality measurement of crude oil. (source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_acid_number). Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

target_gene.description: target gene. Targeted gene or locus name for marker gene studies

target_subfragment.description: target subfragment. Name of subfragment of a gene or locus. Important to e.g. identify special regions on marker genes like V6 on 16S rRNA

tax_class.value: vConTACT vContact2 (references from NCBI RefSeq v83, genus rank classification, default parameters)
tax_class.description: taxonomic classification. Method used for taxonomic classification, along with reference database used, classification rank, and thresholds used to classify new genomes

tax_ident.description: taxonomic identity marker. The phylogenetic marker(s) used to assign an organism name to the SAG or MAG

temp.description: temperature. Temperature of the sample at the time of sampling. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

temp_out.description: temperature outside house. The recorded temperature value at sampling time outside. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

tertiary_treatment.description: tertiary treatment. The process providing a final treatment stage to raise the effluent quality before it is discharged to the receiving environment

tillage.description: history/tillage. Note method(s) used for tilling

time_last_toothbrush.description: time since last toothbrushing. Specification of the time since last toothbrushing. Syntax: ^{duration}$

time_since_last_wash.description: time since last wash. Specification of the time since last wash. Syntax: ^{duration}$

timepoint.description: timepoint. Time point at which a sample or observation is made or taken from a biomaterial as measured from some reference point. Indicate the timepoint written in ISO 8601 format. Syntax: ^{duration}$

tiss_cult_growth_med.description: tissue culture growth media. Description of plant tissue culture growth media used. Syntax: ^({PMID}|{DOI}|{URL}|{text})$

toluene.description: toluene. Concentration of toluene in the sample. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

tot_carb.description: total carbon. Total carbon content. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

tot_depth_water_col.description: total depth of water column. Measurement of total depth of water column. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

tot_inorg_nitro.description: total inorganic nitrogen. Total inorganic nitrogen content. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$

tot_iron.description: total iron. Concentration of total iron in the sample. Syntax: ^{scientific_float}( *- *{scientific_float})? *{text}$
